explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The hypothesis `HasCartanType P b .G2` uses the library's own `HasCartanType` and `DynkinType`, and neither name appears anywhere in this Mathlib version. Mathlib's `RootPairing.isG2_iff` (in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Finite/G2.lean) says that `P.IsG2` holds exactly when `∃ i j, P.pairingIn ℤ i j = -3`. The proof uses it only as the last step. The real work is reading a `-3` pairing off the library's Cartan-type hypothesis via `hasCartanType_iff` and `DynkinType.cartanMatrix_G2_eq`, which are library lemmas. So the content depends on the library's own definitions. I searched Mathlib's RootSystem directory for `IsG2`, `isG2_iff`, `cartanMatrix_G2`, `HasCartanType`, `CartanType` and `DynkinType`.
